criteria.rule: Confirm the tested original finding separately from limitations present on base.
Public contribution/review participation requires genuine responsible-person understanding and assistance disclosure; disclosure alone is insufficient.
Lead with the bounded outcome, one minimal example and at most one needed action. Word length is advisory, never a correctness or acceptance score.

presentation.focus: Tested revisions, Git reference version and the difference between a fixed finding and an existing limitation.
avoid: Fabricating personal understanding or human review.
Presenting agent disclosure as the entire AI policy.

limits: A bounded source snapshot is not a complete policy inventory or current posting authority.
Actor association is recorded verbatim; a collaborator or contributor is not automatically a maintainer.
No personality, acceptance probability or universal AI policy is inferred.
